sentences.english_hint: I brush my teeth first, then go to bed.
sentences.source_note: The learner struggled to form sequences, then successfully used this bedtime example.

sentences.english_hint: Wash your hands first, then eat.
sentences.scenario: Tell your child what to do before eating.
sentences.source_note: The analysis identifies this as the complete structure to replace incomplete attempts.

sentences.chinese: 我的大女儿两岁零七个月。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de dà nǚ'ér liǎng suì líng qī ge yuè.
sentences.english_hint: My older daughter is two years and seven months old.
sentences.scenario: Tell someone your older daughter's age at the time of this lesson.
sentences.source_note: The learner repeatedly used 二岁; the analysis supplies this corrected age statement.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì dì yī jiàn shìqing.
sentences.scenario: Identify the first task in a work plan.
sentences.source_note: Repeated 第一东西 attempts were corrected to 第一件事情 in the analysis.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhōumò jiābān bù hǎo.
sentences.english_hint: I think working overtime on weekends is bad.
sentences.scenario: Give your opinion about weekend overtime.
sentences.source_note: Repeated 工作在周末不好 was corrected to 周末加班不好.

sentences.chinese: 我对我的中文学习很满意。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ duì wǒ de Zhōngwén xuéxí hěn mǎnyì.
sentences.english_hint: I'm very satisfied with my Chinese learning.
sentences.scenario: Tell someone how you feel about studying Chinese.
sentences.source_note: This is the analysis's direct correction of 学习中文是满意.

sentences.chinese: 你对现在的工作满意吗？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ duì xiànzài de gōngzuò mǎnyì ma?
sentences.english_hint: Are you satisfied with your current job?
sentences.scenario: Ask a friend how they feel about their job.
sentences.source_note: The learner repeatedly struggled with 对……满意 while discussing jobs and salaries.

sentences.chinese: 我们可以提前一个星期完成。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ tíqián yí ge xīngqī wánchéng.
sentences.english_hint: We can finish a week early.
sentences.scenario: Practice giving an early completion estimate at work.
sentences.source_note: The lesson's project dialogue introduced 提前一个星期完成.

sentences.chinese: 这个项目能按时完成吗？
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù néng ànshí wánchéng ma?
sentences.english_hint: Can this project be finished on time?
sentences.source_note: The analysis prioritizes 按时 in contrast with 提前 and 推迟.

sentences.chinese: 项目可能要推迟一个星期。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù kěnéng yào tuīchí yí ge xīngqī.
sentences.english_hint: The project may be delayed by a week.
sentences.scenario: Practice warning a colleague about a possible delay.
sentences.source_note: The project exercises practiced possible delays and reinforced 推迟了一个星期.

sentences.pinyin: Tuō le jǐ tiān cái wánchéng.
sentences.english_hint: It was only finished after a few days' delay.
sentences.scenario: Explain when a delayed task finally got done.
sentences.source_note: The analysis uses 拖了几天才完成 to teach 才 for a delayed result.

sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài qù jīchǎng lái de jí ma?
sentences.english_hint: Can we make it if we head to the airport now?
sentences.scenario: Ask your driver whether there is still enough time.
sentences.source_note: The learner repeatedly struggled with 来得及 and used an airport journey to understand it.

sentences.chinese: 今天来不及和你吃饭了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān lái bu jí hé nǐ chīfàn le.
sentences.english_hint: I don't have time to eat with you today.
sentences.scenario: Cancel a meal because you are short of time.
sentences.source_note: The analysis gives this meal example to reinforce 来不及 as insufficient time.

sentences.chinese: 我再也不去那个饭馆了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài yě bú qù nàge fànguǎn le.
sentences.english_hint: I'm never going to that restaurant again.
sentences.scenario: React to the disappointing restaurant you discussed.
sentences.source_note: The learner described a disappointing restaurant in France; the analysis teaches 再也不……了.
